platform_name: Qinsight Atlas — Cryptographic Discovery & Posture Management Platform
product_brief: Cryptographic posture management platform that discovers, inventories, and risk-assesses cryptography (keys, certificates, algorithms) for quantum readiness.
pqc_support: Partial — discovery, inventory, and risk assessment of quantum-vulnerable vs. PQC-ready algorithms; no PQC algorithm implementation stated
pqc_capability_description: The platform classifies algorithms and flags what is "at risk" vs. PQC-ready, flags classical and post-quantum risks, and maps reports to NIST PQC migration frameworks and CNSA 2.0. It provides PQC risk assessment and guided remediation, not PQC cryptographic implementations. No specific PQC algorithms named.
architecture_type: Lightweight sensors and API integrations for discovery; REST API; deployment model (SaaS vs on-prem) not stated
primary_platforms: Cloud, code, endpoints, IT and OT environments (discovery targets)
cryptographic_discovery_&_inventory: Automated discovery of keys, certificates, algorithms, protocols, and secrets across cloud, code, endpoints, IT and OT; builds a CBOM for each source scanned; enriches with CMDB context; rules engine flags weak/quantum-vulnerable or non-compliant crypto; continuous monitoring and scheduled scans.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Guided remediation workflows with fixes prioritized by severity; guided crypto-agility workflows and APIs support remediation; lightweight sensors used for discovery. Effort, rollback, and compatibility not stated.

evidence.PQC Support: Qinsight classifies algorithms and flags what's "at risk" vs. PQC-ready so teams can see exposure at a glance.
evidence.PQC Capability Description: Built-in reports and dashboards map to compliance requirements like PCI-DSS and CNSA 2.0 as well as NIST PQC migration frameworks.
